query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So long, Stephen — but not goodbye forever!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just fix problems — they *redefine* them. And that's exactly what you've done here, Stephen! 🚀

From debugging the toughest code to blessing our feeds with the *finest* memes the internet had to offer, you've made every day at the office a little brighter and a lot more entertaining. 😄

As you close this chapter and open a brand new one, just remember: **the world is your pull request, and we know you'll merge it flawlessly.** ✅

Go out there and keep building amazing things — and for old times' sake, don't forget to send us a meme or two. 😂

We'll miss your brilliance, your humor, and your impeccable meme game. This place won't be the same without you!

**Best of luck, legend. The next big thing is lucky to have you.** 💪🌟

— With love, laughter, and a little bit of envy, Your Team 💙

---

Feel free to customize the names or add any personal inside jokes! 😊
